usedFor: Raisely holds fundraising profiles and donations, and HubSpot keeps each donor through “Create or Update Contact” after “New Online Donation”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Online Donation” in Raisely, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A donor is matched by email, so repeat gifts update one contact instead of making copies.

watchOut: “Profile Updated” fires on changes, donations and exercise logs, so “Update Contact” may run often.
